title: Guy Has An Emotional Breakdown After Making The Dumbest Mistake
description:
#news #police #arrest

On February 12th, 2022. Officers responded to a possible intoxicated driver in a drive-thru. The driver had driven into the drive-thru the wrong way and got their vehicle stuck on a curb. When the officers approached him, she could smell a strong odor of alcohol on his breath.
